platforms.name: Apify Store
platforms.fees: 20% commission plus platform usage costs; $20 minimum via PayPal/Wise, $100 other methods
warnings: Free-plan users do not generate creator revenue

platforms.name: Polar
platforms.fees: Starter: 5% + $0.50 per transaction; payout fees may also apply
platforms.discovery: Checkout infrastructure; not primarily a discovery marketplace
warnings: Main account review occurs before first payout

platforms.name: Gumroad
platforms.fees: Platform transaction fees apply; Discover sales carry a higher marketplace fee
platforms.discovery: Gumroad Discover is available but not guaranteed
warnings: Portugal payouts are in EUR to a local bank account

platforms.name: Ko-fi Shop
platforms.fees: 5% service fee on Shop sales plus PayPal/Stripe processing fees
platforms.discovery: Primarily creator-led traffic; weak native discovery
warnings: Payments go directly to the connected processor

platforms.name: itch.io
platforms.fees: Open revenue share plus processor fees; payout mode has a $5 minimum and a one-time tax identity fee
platforms.discovery: Native marketplace, strongest for games and creator tools
warnings: Payout mode requires tax interview and review

platforms.name: GitHub public release
platforms.fees: No listing fee; no built-in payment for ordinary repositories or Actions
warnings: Distribution path only; payment_path_ready means publishable, not monetized
